summary.text: Shae Sortwell is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 2, where he took office on January 7, 2019, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Democrat Alicia Saunders.

paragraphs.text: Shae Sortwell joined the Assembly in January 2019.

For 2025-2026 his committee assignments were Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Energy and Utilities, Insurance, Regulatory Licensing Reform, where he was chair, Sporting Heritage, and Government Accountability and Oversight, where he was vice chair.
